Are you searching for a job on your own and unsure where to start?

At the group company interview event, you can speak directly with company representatives without needing to pass a document screening first. This is a chance to learn about companies and their work firsthand.

Use this opportunity to meet potential employers and find work that fits you!

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2834/
